༄༅/ /lam zab bla ma sgrub pa'i dmigs rim bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// lam zab bla ma sgrub pa'i dmigs rim bzhugs so//

༄༅// na maḥsarba dzñā dha rma rā dza wa gind+ra// mkhyen pa'i pha mtha' mi mngon zhing*// brtse ba'i rba rlabs g.yo ba can/ rtogs pa'i yid bzhin nor bus bltams// yongs 'dzin chu gter dbang por 'dud// dkar rgyud kun gyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam// mdo rgyud kun gyi snying phyung bla ma yi// sgrub thabs zab mo slob bus bskul ba'i ngor// bla ma mkha' 'gror bzod gsol bri bar bya// de yang lam zab mo bla ma sgrub pa'i zhal gdams la/ sngon 'gro bslab pa gsum la bslab pa/ dngos gzhi smin grol gnyis la bslab pa/ rjes ngo sprod pa la bslab pa dang gsum las/ dang po dam tshig gtsang ma la bslab pa dang*/ tshogs bsags pa la bslab pa dang*/ gsol ba 'debs pa la bslab pa dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ bla ma dang mched grogs la dam tshig ma nyams par bya zhing*/ phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyi rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas rgyun du bya ba yin no// gnyis pa ni/ sbyin gtong ci 'byor pa bgyid cing*/ bsgrub pa'i maṇḍal bkod la/ mchod pa'i maṇḍal 'bul ba la bslab pa'o// gsum pa ni/ spyi bo'i gtsug gam snying gi dkyil lam/ mdun gyi nam mkha' gang rung du bla ma bsgom la lus longs spyod 'bul zhing ma nam mkha' sogs kyis gsol 'debs kha tshig tsam min par snying khong rus pa'i gting nas 'debs pa la bslab pa rnams so// dngos gzhi la/ smin par byed pa'i dbang gis smin par byas la/ lung 'bum la sogs pa sngon du 'gro ba byas nas/ phyi sgrub nang sgrub la sogs pa'i zhal shes rnams/ mtshams lo gsum mam/ lo gcig gam zla ba brgyad kyi bka' rgya btab la byin/ de la dang po phyi sgrub kyi dmigs pa ni/ sgrub pa ci tsam byed pa'i bar gyi mthun rkyen tshang bar bsags nas phyi spyad nang du mi gtong*/ nang spyad phyir mi gtong*/ chu dgos dus chu dar 'phyar/ bug sgo'i phyir mtho dkar po cig brtsig la sgor sa de/

spyan ras gzigs phyag stong spyan stong du gsal ba la ma ṇi stong ngam brgya/ sgo tshun gyi spyil po'i rgya de spyan ras gzigs zhal gcig phyag bzhi par bsgom la ma ṇi stong ngam brgya/ mal de nyid kha sar pa ṇir bsgoms la ma ṇi stong ngam brgya/ sku de gsum ka'ang gcig gi thugs kar gcig bzhugs pa| kha sar pa ṇi'i thugs kar rang yod pa'i mdun du zhing khams gser gyi sa gzhi lag mthil ltar 'khod snyoms pa'i dbus su baṃ las bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho/ de'i dbus su paṃ las dpag bsam shing gi sdong po rtsa ba gcig la yal ga du mar gyes pa'i steng du 'dab drug brtsegs lha'i gos gyis klubs pa'i khar/ ngo bo drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma/ rnam pa rdo rje 'chang du gsal ba'i dbu thog nas yar/ brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams mtho brtsegs su bzhugs pa la dus gsum gyi bla mas bskor ba/ mdun du pad nyi'i gdan la bde mchog 'khor lo la yi dam lha tshogs kyis bskor ba/ g.yas su pad zla'i gdan la shākya thub pa la dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyis bskor ba/ rgyab tu yum chen mo la lung rtogs kyi chos kyis bskor ba| g.yon du spyan ras gzigs la 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams kyis bskor ba'i phyogs mtshams thams cad du dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma rnams sprin gyi phung po gtibs pa ltar gsal bas/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che thob par bya/ de'i phyir du lam zab mo bla ma sgrub snyam pa'i bsam pas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed lan gsum bya/ rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas byas/ gong gi skyabs yul slar yang gsal bar dmigs la/ bla ma dam pa rje btsun pa'i maṇḍal nyi shu rtsa gcig 'bul zhing 'dod don gsol ba btab/ yan lag bdun pa'i thog ma phyag 'tshal ba ni rang gi lus 'di rab byung ba'i cha byad gzhon zhing mdzes pa zhing gi rdul snyed du sprul te/

mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad kyang rab tu byung ba'i cha byad du gsal nas ram 'degs par bsam nas/ ma nam ma'i phyag stong btsal la/ phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod bas mchod/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa zhes sogs kyis stobs bzhi'i sgo nas sdig pa bshags rjes su yi rangs 'bul/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i sku'i sgo nas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar stsal du gsol/ bdag gis sprul sku 'grub par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ gsung gi longs sku 'grub par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ thugs kyi chos sku 'grub par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba gdab| skyabs yul rnams rim pas bla ma la thim/ rang spyan ras gzigs su gsal btab pa'i spyi bor bla ma spyan drangs/ ma lus kun khyab mas gsol ba btab/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang blangs/ rang la bstim mnyam par gzhag /de las skyo na dge ba 'di yis gyur du bdag /ces sogs dang*/ bdag gis dpal ldan bla ma dam pa 'grub par gyur cig /'grub nas 'gro ba sems can gyi don rgya chen po 'grub par gyur cig /ces pa'i smon lam 'debs shing phung po'i tshogs 'khor dang gtor ma'i rnal 'byor gang 'grub byed pa'o| /gnyis pa/ maṇḍal yan phyi sgrub bzhin la/ rang nyid bde mchog lhan skyes su gsal btab pa'i spyi bo na yar bla bsgrub brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams gsal btab/ lus longs spyod kyi dngos po phul/ brgyud pa'i gsol ba btab/ rim gyis rtsa ba'i bla ma la thim/ de la ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang blangs/ 'od du zhu rang la thim/ mnyam par gzhag /de las skyo na'ang bde mchog lhan skyes yab yum phyi gsal nang gsal du gsal ba'i lus kyi dbus drangs por rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi dang bcas pa/ gsang gnas kyi rtsa 'dab sum cu rtsa gnyis la/ bla ma don yod grub pa/ yab yum so gnyis/ lte ba'i rtsa 'dab drug cu rtsa bzhi la bla ma rin chen 'byung ldan ser po yab yum rtsa grangs dang mnyam pa/

snying kha'i rtsa 'dab brgyad la bla ma mi bskyod pa sngon po yab yum brgyad/ mgrin par rtsa 'dab bcu drug la bla ma 'od dpag med dmar po yab yum bcu drug /spyi bor rtsa 'dab so gnyis la bla ma rnam snang dkar po yab yum so gnyis gsal btab ye shes sems dpa'i tshul dang ma nam mkha' ma/ gang gi 'khor ba'i nyes pa ni// zhes sogs kyis phyag sogs yan lag bdun pa 'bul/ ma nam ma bzhi bskor lan bdun gyi rjes su/ ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla ma sangs rgyas rin po che la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes pa stong phrag gcig song ba dang*/ ma lus kun khyab ma'i gsol 'debs tshar gcig gi rjes su/ mdun gyi bla ma lhan skyes kyi gsang gnas kyi don grub yab yum 'od du zhu/ rang gi gsang gnas kyi don grub yab yum la thim pas/ 'du byed gyi phung po sbyangs| phrag dog gi dri ma dag /bya ba grub pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ don yod grub pa'i 'phrin las la dbang zhing*/ don yod grub pa'i go 'phang mngon du bya/ sngo ba smon lam bya ba snga thun no// gung thun la gsol ba 'debs pa yan gong bzhin la/ mdun gyi bla ma lhan skyes kyi lte ba'i rin chen 'byung ldan yab yum 'od du zhu/ rang gi lte ba'i rin chen 'byung gnas yab yum rnams la thim/ tshor ba'i phung po sbyangs/ nga rgyal gyi dri ma dag /mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyi 'phrin las la dbang zhing*/ rin 'byung gi go 'phang mngon du bya/ mthar bsngo ba byed pa gung thun no// yang gsol ba 'debs pa yan gong bzhin la/ mdun gyi he ru ka'i thugs ka'i mi bskyod pa yab yum rang gi snying ga'i mi bskyod pa yab yum la thim/ rnam par shes pa'i phung po sbyangs/ zhe sdang gi dri ma dag /me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du byas/ mi bskyod pa'i 'phrin las la dbang zhing*/ mi bskyod pa'i go 'phang mngon du bya/

bsngo ba smon lam byed pa phyi thun no// yang gzhan gong ltar la/ bla ma'i mgrin pa'i 'od dpag med yab yum 'od du zhu/ rang gi mgrin pa'i 'od dpag med yab yum la thim/ 'du shes kyi phung po sbyangs/ 'dod chags kyi dri ma dag /so sor rtog pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ 'od dpag med kyi 'phrin las la dbang zhing*/ 'od dpag med kyi go 'phang mngon du bya/ bsdo ba smon lam byed pa srod thun no// yang gzhan gong ltar la bla ma'i spyi bo'i rnam par snang mdzad yab yum 'od du zhu/ rang gi spyi bo'i rnam par snang mdzad yab yum la thim/ gzugs kyi phung po sbyangs/ gti mug gi dri ma dag /chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi 'phrin las la dbang zhing*/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi go 'phang mngon du bya/ bsngo ba smon lam byed pa gung thun no// de nas thor thun la/ yang gzhan gong ltar la/ mdun gyi lhan skyes yab yum 'od du zhu/ rang gi spyi bo nas rim pa bzhin du gnas lnga'i lha tshogs la dbang bskur/ lus gang*/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las spyi bor bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen pos dbu brgyan/ mnyam par gzhag pa ni don kyi bla ma sgrub pa'o// mthar bsngo ba smon lam bgyid pa ni nang sgrub bo// gsum pa ni/ srung 'khor nas bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi bar gong bzhin la/ tshad med bzhi bsgom pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ sems can thams cad kyi don du bdag gis lam zab mo bla ma sgrub snyam pa'i bsam pas tshad med bzhi bsgom/ bskyed rim lha'i rnal 'byor ni/ rang nyid bde mchog lhan skyes su gsal btab pa'i thugs kar bla ma bde mchog tu gsal ba'i thugs khar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ yig ye shes lnga ldan/ mtha' mar oṃ āḥgu ru ḍā ki nī sidhi hūm̐/ zhes pas bskor ba la gsal 'debs pa ni bzlas pa sngags kyi rnal 'byor ro// 'od zer spro bsdu'i rnal 'byor la/

thugs ka'i sngags 'phreng las 'od zer dkar po dpag tu med pa 'phros/ sangs rgyas byang sems rnams la mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib ma lus pa sbyangs/ slar rgyal ba ma lus pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs thams cad 'od zer gyi tshul du bsdus nas sngags 'phreng la thim par bsam zhing*/ sngags bzlas pas 'od zer spro bsdu yang yang bya/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ rnam pa lha sku rang bzhin stong nyid spros pa'i mtha' dang bral ba'i bde stong dbyer med zung 'jug gi ngang la 'jog pa ni don gyi bla ma sgrub pa ste/ de las skyon bsngo ba smon lam gyis rgyas 'debs pa bsngo ba smon lam gyi rnal 'byor/ sbyin sreg gi rnal 'byor ni/ snga dgong thab bsangs me lha bskyed pa'i lto bar khog ma gzhal yas khang*/ rdzas bde mchog zhu ba'i bdud rtsir bsam/ rang lus bde mchog tu gsal ba'i lce chung bla ma lhan skyes yab yum/ lce me lha/ kha hom khung*/ lag pa dgang blugs zas bde ba'i mchod pas bla ma mchod pas/ sku las bde ba'i rgyun babs pas 'khor lo bzhi gang*/ 'phrin las bzhi la dbang bar bsgom/ gtor ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ gtor ma byin gyis rlabs/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsir bsam la/ bla ma bde mchog yab yum dus gsum gyi rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad spyan drangs gtor ma dbul/ mthar mchod bstod byed/ chogs 'khor gyi rnal 'byor ni/ rang tha mal gyi lus shes pa rnal 'byor mar gyur pa spyi bo nas 'thon/ phyag g.yas gri gug gis smin mtshams nas thod pa bregs pa/ mdun du rang byung gi mi mgo'i sgyed bu gsum gyi steng du thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du lus 'di bcug la gri gug gis rug gi gtubs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs pa/ rnal 'byor ma'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas bla ma yi dam/

rgyal ba rgyal sras/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro srung ma rigs drug gi sems can thams cad bla ma bde mchog yab yum gyi rnam par spyan drangs/ de dag gi ljags 'od kyi spu gu can kyis gsol bas zag med kyi bde bas dgyes par bsam zhing*/ mchod pa'i rdzas mi dmigs mchod yul mi dmigs pa'i 'khor gsum yongs dag gi ngang la mnyam par gzhag /'od gsal gyi rnal 'byor ni/ snying gar padma 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte bar nyi zla'i gdan la bla ma'i sku shel ltar dngas pa'i thugs kar shes pa gtang pas gnyid 'od gsal du 'jug pa'i rnal 'byor ro// bzhi sgrub 'phrin las kyi bsnyen pa ni/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor yan gong bzhin la/ rang nyid bde mchog lhan skyes rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi dang*/ stong rar gsal ba'i spyi bo nas lte ba'i bar gyi lha grangs nang sgrub bzhin gsal btab/ thun mong la yan lag bdun pa bsdus pa cig phul la/ thugs kar hūm̐ yig gi mthar sngags 'phreng dkar po gsal btab la/ oṃ āḥgu ru ḍā ki ni siddhi hūm̐/ zhes brgya stong khri 'bum la sogs bzlas pas 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros pa la brten/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib thams cad zhi bar byas/ sangs rgyas thams cad mnyes pa'i mchod pa dbul/ 'od zer byin rlabs kyi rnam par bsdus te/ sngags 'phreng la thim pas rang gi chos sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi bar bsam bsngo ba smon lam bya/ snga thun la| lte ba'i lha tshogs gsal btab pa la yan lag bdun pa phul nas 'od zer ser po'i spro bsdus rang gi tshe dang bsod nams thams cad rgyas par bsam/ phyi thun la mgrin pa'i lha tshogs gsal btab pa la yan lag bdun pa 'bul ba nas 'od zer dmar po'i spro bsdus 'gro ba thams cad dbang du 'dus par bsam/ srod thun la snying ga'i lha tshogs gsal btab pa la yan lag bdun pa 'bul zhing 'od zer nag po'i spro bsdus bstan pa la gnod pa/

rang gi sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad tshar bcad par bsam zhing*/ thun re bzhin bsngo ba smon lam gyi rgyas 'debs pa byed/ rjes ngo sprad pa ni/ rang sems skye ba med pa cir yang 'char ba gsal gzhag dang dgag sgrub thams cad dang bral ba bde stong lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes de la gzhi phyag rgya chen po zer te/ rje dwags po lha rjes/ sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa chos kyi sku/ de kha'i ngang nas snang srid thams cad bla ma sku gsum gyi rol par 'char zhing*/ de dag kyang rang bzhin dag pa chos sku/ rnam pa dag pa longs sku/ byed las dag pa sprul sku yin pas/ snang grags kyi chos thams cad chos sku'i rtsal/ de laṃ phyag rgya chen po zer te/ snang ba lhan cig skyes pa chos sku'i 'od/ ces gsungs so/ mdor snang ba dang stong pa dbyer med snang ba dang sems nyid dbyer med/ 'khor 'das dbyer med rnams la 'bras bu phyag rgya chen po zer ba yin te/ de phyir snang sems dbyer med lhan cig skyes/ zhes gsungs pa yin no/ zhes 'di chos kyi gter mdzod pas// skul ngor ngag dbang nor bu yis// chos kyis 'tsho ba'i cog sgar du// sbyar ba'i yi ge bla rgyam gyis// bgyis pa'i dge bas rnam mkhyen shog /dpe mi bstan par thugs nyams su blangs 'tshal lo// //maṅga laṃ//
